body:
Adds milestone 8, `site-redesign`, to the Repository merge action list in `PROJECTS.md`. This is the owner's request to redesign the GitHub Pages homepages:

- Give the research homepage (`site/`) and the product catalogue (`oss-monorepo` `platform/pages/build.mjs`) a modern, professional design with better HTML, CSS and JS: design tokens, light and dark themes, responsive layout, sticky navigation, a hero, featured work, and client-side search and filtering, all accessible and with no framework.
- Add one super homepage that routes to both sites, ideally at the `oss-monorepo` Pages root with the research site at `/research/`, and keep the old URLs working.
- Keep every existing feature: cards, test counts, disclaimers, usage tracking, SEO and sitemaps. The definition of done includes screenshots at phone and desktop widths.

This change touches docs only. `python site/build.py` prints `ok: 392 projects, 3421 tests`.
